services.name: Muay Thai
services.desc: Jiu-Jitsu classes can bring a new surrounding of positivity into kids' lives. At Gracie Barra Santa Barbara, we specialize in teaching Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Muay Thai to children of all ages. We take immense pride in our ability to help kids learn and become disciplined. We want them to have fun but also become more knowledgeable in defending themselves and improving their self-confidence. Our Martial Arts program will teach your child how to stand up for themselves, deal with their fears, encourage teamwork, instill perseverance and integrity, utilize problem-solving skills, and other traits that can be both used in and out of the classroom. See more of the benefits of martial arts

services.name: Jiu-Jitsu programs
services.desc: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is like any other sport or activity: your progress is a consequence of how hard and how smart you work. Group classes are the best proven way to teach Jiu-Jitsu, since the diversity of training partners creates more and different challenges allowing a student to improve more quickly. However, private classes are definitely an essential complement that no serious Jiu-Jitsu student should do without. The individual attention and approach that a 60-minute session with one of our instructors provides can lead to significant improvement in a student’s Jiu-Jitsu game flow. It is highly recommended that all students take at least one private lesson per month to review
